scope: Read-only authorization of stored Planner operations with protected original sources
implementation: The existing live verifier may enter the recorded path only when the actual forecast or amount producer reports stale. Denied/unavailable producers do not gain a fallback.

The recorded verifier requires the complete supplied case/scenario/result to match current protected C08 state, current membership and principal/access/policy. Native case ID/incarnation/version is checked without rewriting any binding.

Original projections and canonical monthly planner-value selections come from BCS/C17. At least one historical protected capture is required; currentRef/current authority and physical continuity remain the existing C17 producer responsibility.

Two complete source observations and a final C08 case reread fence changes; original historical context and bytes remain unchanged. A recursion sentinel is deleted at return and never caches an authorization.
The stored scenario/result is read unchanged. Canonical Planner simulation, operation admission, prepare and execution are not replaced, relaxed or routed through this reader.
